page.emptyState: Create a board to start tracking cards for this repository.
deleteCard.title: Delete this card?
deleteCard.description: "{{title}}" and its comments are removed for good. Archiving hides it instead, and keeps it.
card.description.label: Description
card.tags.label: Tags
card.tags.empty: No tags yet — type a name to create one.
card.dod.label: Definition of Done
card.dod.placeholder: - [ ] Something that must be true before this is done
card.blocked.label: Blocked
card.blocked.reasonRequired: Describe what the card is blocked on to mark it blocked.
card.comments.label: Comments
attachment.hint: Paste or drop an image or video to attach it
attachment.hintRemote: Paste or drop a file — commit and push it for teammates to see it
card.branch.label: Branch
createBoard.title: New board
createBoard.localDescription: Private to you, stored in this repo's own .git — never pushed or shared.
createBoard.remoteDescription: Shared with the team — cards are GitHub issues, columns are labels.
createBoard.remoteUnavailable: Connect a GitHub account for this repository to use a shared board.
columnEditor.title: Edit columns
columnEditor.isDoneHint: Cards in a "done" column count as finished in the sprint report, and aren't carried over when the sprint is closed.
boardSettings.title: Board settings
boardSettings.tagsHint: A card's tags paint a coloured stripe down its left edge.
boardSettings.dodHint: Copied into every new card, and freely editable per card afterwards. Changing it never rewrites existing cards.
boardSettings.prefixHint: A card keeps the prefix it was created with, so this list only changes what new cards are offered.
deleteBoard.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteBoard.description: This removes the board and its column layout. Cards on a GitHub-backed board stay open, just unlabeled — nothing on GitHub is deleted.
sprint.readOnly: This sprint is closed. Its cards are read-only.
sprint.carryOverLabel: Start the next sprint and carry the unfinished cards over
sprint.carryOverHint_one: {{count}} unfinished card will move to the new sprint. The cards keep their comments and checklists.
sprint.carryOverHint_other: {{count}} unfinished cards will move to the new sprint. The cards keep their comments and checklists.
sprint.carryOverNoneHint: Everything is done — the new sprint starts empty.
sprint.carriedOver: The unfinished cards moved to a new sprint.
conflict.message: This changed since it was last loaded — refreshed with the latest version.
addIssue.title: Add an existing issue
addIssue.description: Pick one of the repository's open issues, or paste a number or URL. The card will track it.
addIssue.searchPlaceholder: Search, or paste #42 or a GitHub URL
card.tracking.label: Tracked issue
card.tracking.unreachable: Could not reach GitHub — showing the last known content.
card.tracking.untrackHint: The card keeps its content and stops following the issue.
card.tracking.syncNote: Editing this card edits the GitHub issue.
addIssue.alreadyOnBoard: Issue #{{number}} is already on this board.
archived.title: Archived cards
archived.description: Cards taken off the board but kept. Restore one, open it, or delete it for good.
moveCard.title: Move to another board
moveCard.description: The card keeps its content, its checklist and its discussion.
moveCard.descriptionRemote: The card becomes a real GitHub issue, and leaves this board. Its comments stay behind — they were written here.
moveCard.noTargets: There is no other board to move this card to.
card.links.label: Relations
card.links.noCandidates: No other card on this board.
card.status.label: Column
write.failed: That change could not be saved.
card.links.missing: A card that no longer exists
archived.dangerZoneHint_one: Emptying the archive destroys the card in it, with its description, checklist and comments. This cannot be undone.
archived.dangerZoneHint_other: Emptying the archive destroys all {{count}} cards in it, with their descriptions, checklists and comments. This cannot be undone.
purgeArchived.description_one: The card and everything on it — description, checklist, comments — is removed for good. Nothing in the app brings it back.
purgeArchived.description_other: All {{count}} cards and everything on them — descriptions, checklists, comments — are removed for good. Nothing in the app brings them back.
column.actions.archiveAll_one: Archive the card in this column
column.actions.archiveAll_other: Archive all {{count}} cards in this column
column.actions.moveAll_one: Move the card to another board
column.actions.moveAll_other: Move all {{count}} cards to another board
archiveColumn.title: Archive everything in "{{column}}"?
archiveColumn.description_one: The card in "{{column}}" leaves the board and goes to the archive, where you can restore it at any time.
archiveColumn.description_other: All {{count}} cards in "{{column}}" leave the board and go to the archive, where you can restore them at any time.
moveColumn.title: Move everything out of "{{column}}"
moveColumn.description_one: The card in "{{column}}" moves to the board you pick, keeping its identifier, comments and history.
moveColumn.description_other: All {{count}} cards in "{{column}}" move to the board you pick, keeping their identifiers, comments and history.
moveColumn.noTargets: There is no other open board on this backend to move them to.
createBoard.iterationDescription: A sprint that ends: it can be closed, which freezes a report and carries the leftovers into the next one. It will be created as "{{example}}".
createBoard.standingDescription: A standing board that never ends — a backlog a ticket passes through before it reaches a sprint. It offers no closing.
sprint.archiveDoneHint_one: {{count}} card in the column below leaves the board for the archive, so the closed sprint is not left holding it. Restorable at any time.
sprint.archiveDoneHint_other: {{count}} cards in the column below leave the board for the archive, so the closed sprint is not left holding them. Restorable at any time.
deleteBoard.remote.deleteCardsHint: Every issue on this board is closed on GitHub. Closed, not deleted: GitHub has no way to delete an issue.
deleteBoard.local.deleteCardsHint: The board and its tickets are erased from this machine, backup included. Nothing brings them back.
deleteBoard.local.archiveCardsHint: The tickets are archived and stay findable by search. The board is kept so they still have one — out of the list, read only, shown again by "Show deleted".
deleteBoard.remote.archiveCardsHint: The issues stay open and gain the "archived" label. The board is kept so they still have one — out of the list, read only, shown again by "Show deleted".
deleteBoard.deletedNotice: This board was deleted. Its tickets were archived rather than destroyed, which is why it is still here.
